critique.evidence: The screen has a clear signature idea: a harmless storefront is visibly overwritten by a red, scan-lined “machine-visible retrieval layer,” with authorized intent and recorded outcome contrasted inside the reveal. The Agent Vision framing, oversized thesis headline, cyan control-point marker, and red forensic overlay make the injection seam understandable and recognizable at a glance rather than reading as a generic dashboard. The concept remains visible across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
critique.fix: Refine the mobile reveal: reduce the ghosted storefront interference, prevent dense labels from competing, and give the authorized/outcome comparison more breathing room so the signature red-layer moment feels as deliberate as it does on desktop.
